draft.subject: digital order records
draft.body:
Hi Paula,

A different angle. New HMRC rules from April require every wholesaler to keep digital records of each order line.

We built a citizen-services digital transformation platform with workflow automation and dashboards.

Is getting orders into a digital system on your list for next year?

evidence.text: Order Administrator. Key trade customer orders from email and phone into our system and raise delivery notes.
